name.ja: サイバー・アルナイル

text.en: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) while you control a Machine "Cyber" monster. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Cyber Emergency" from your Deck to your hand. If this card is banished: You can activate this effect; during the End Phase of this turn, shuffle up to 7 of your banished Machine "Cyber" monsters into the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Cyber Alnair" once per turn.
